instruction: Turn on Windows Narrator. In Google Maps, set Marina Bay Sands, Singapore as the current location. Search for pharmacies and choose the pharmacy with the shortest displayed walking distance from Marina Bay Sands; if distances tie, choose the shorter walking time. Open that pharmacy's place details and leave them open.
gt_steps: Set Marina Bay Sands, Singapore as the current location.
Search for pharmacies near the set current location.
Compare the displayed walking distances from Marina Bay Sands to the nearby pharmacies.
Identify Guardian Health & Beauty + Pharmacy  Marina Bay Sands (Click & Collect), located at 2 Bayfront Ave, B2-49, The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore 018972, as the nearest pharmacy.
Open the Guardian Health & Beauty + Pharmacy  Marina Bay Sands (Click & Collect) place details.
